name: Cockpit
description: A New Tab page that is a cockpit (what needs you, your PRs, your workspaces) and a Needs You section on top of the sidebar.

scopes.agent_chat:read: Read your agent chats, to list the ones waiting on you.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a workspace or a chat's workspace when you click it.
scopes.actions:run: Open a chat, a terminal, a browser or a PR from the page.
scopes.integration:github:read: Read your pull requests with the connected GitHub account.
